methodologyNotes: Covers standalone residential gun safes and rifle/long-gun safes sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes soft cases, trigger locks, unlocked cabinets, and in-vehicle lockboxes. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. gunCapacity is the manufacturer-advertised long-gun (rifle/shotgun) capacity as a count; it is the nominal published number, not de-rated for scopes. lockType is an enum: mechanical-dial, electronic-keypad, biometric, or rfid. fireRatingMinutes is the manufacturer or UL-rated time the interior stays below ~350 degrees F; null if the safe carries no fire rating. fireRatingTempF is the external furnace temperature at which that fire rating was measured, in degrees F; null if unrated. ulRscListed is a boolean: true only if the model is independently UL-listed as a Residential Security Container (UL 1037 / RSC), false for manufacturer-claimed-only burglary ratings. bodySteelGauge is the body wall steel gauge as a number (lower gauge = thicker steel). boltCount is the number of active (moving) locking bolts. exteriorDimsIn is exterior height x width x depth in inches, excluding the handle. weightLbs is empty shipping/unloaded weight in pounds. waterResistant is a boolean for a manufacturer-rated water, flood, or smoke-seal claim.
